title: stacked_kit capability registry (SSOT)
description: Single source of truth for capability->kit routing and each kit's typed export vocabularies. The two markdown routing tables (skills/_kit-system.md §4 and kit_matrix.md §2/§3) become GENERATED views of this file (write-on-diff + fixity --check); the fragile hand-maintained precedence rule between them is retired. translate_design validates every translation-map.json '.kit' token against the typed `provides` vocabularies here (widget | service.method | motion:preset [+ KitMotionSpec.variant]). MANUAL fields (hand-authored routing): dir, package, capabilities, backing, topology, phase, playbook, hasSkill. GENERATED/GATED fields: provides.* (barrel-derived; kit_registry.py check-vocab asserts every symbol exists in the kit's source so provides cannot drift or reference fiction).

providers.description: External-service providers whose verification tier gates whether a surface may offer them. verification is EVIDENCE — set only by a tier suite (tools/verification/), never hand-edited; gates/advertise cross-checks it against the evidence ledger. stub = no suite has run.

provides.description: Typed export vocabularies (closed kit Slot vocabularies). Empty {} = pending generation via `kit_registry.py gen-vocab`.

services.description: Exported Kit* service classes with their callable method vocabulary.

motion_presets.description: Closed motion-preset vocabulary (sealed flags in translate_design.py, e.g. 'rise-in').
